title: 第270章 真是搞笑第269章 你又变强了
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了第一卷：默认第270章真是搞笑（..la）石峰、叶尘、封狼三人再次对视一眼，同时轻轻摇了摇头。
石峰谨慎开口：“目前还说不准。
要是今晚他们依旧不出现，我们再重新调整计划，另做打算。”
叶尘立刻补充道：“我早就安排人手守住了全城所有出城关卡，只要他们想离开汕城，我们第一时间就能收到消息，绝对跑不掉。”
封狼沉着脸，冷声道：“陈阳那小子性子嚣张狂妄，傲气十足，绝对不会轻易狼狈逃走。”
几人正交谈之际，酒店门外的夜空光影一闪。
陈阳稳稳落地，直接解除隐身状态，身形显露在夜色之中。
他双眼微光亮起，催动透视能力，快速扫视整座酒店大堂，将内部场景尽收眼底。
转瞬之间，他就锁定了大堂内的石峰、叶尘、封狼三位长老，以及刚刚赶来的赵威一行人。
他再次快速扫视大堂其余角落，确认没有埋伏，也完全不见林昊的身影，才将目光重新落回赵威四人身上。
陈阳心底一阵狂喜，暗自感叹：真是天助我也！
只要把这几人的修为全部吸走，自己绝对有机会一举突破到炼气境九层后期。
到那时，自身实力彻底追平林昊，再对上他，胜算就会大大提升，对付起来会轻松太多。
想到这里，陈阳心底满是激动，不再迟疑，身形一闪，直接快步冲进酒店大堂。
踏入大堂的瞬间，他目光淡淡扫过四人，语气带着几分戏谑：“怎么？你们这么大阵仗，是专门在这里等着我？”
骤然听见声音，赵威、石峰、叶尘、封狼，以及两名弟子的目光齐刷刷聚焦在陈阳身上，气氛瞬间紧绷。
看清来人样貌的一刻，石峰、叶尘、封狼三位长老脸色骤变，满脸震惊，眼神中满是难以置信，完全没想到陈阳居然真的敢孤身找上门来。
赵威敏锐察觉到三位长老的异样，转头看向石峰，沉声确认：“石长老，这小子就是陈阳？”
“没错，就是他！”石峰咬牙点头，眼底满是忌惮与恨意。
赵威上下打量着眼前的陈阳，对方年纪轻轻，气息内敛，他全力探查，却完全看不透对方的修为深浅。

即便如此，他依旧满脸喜色，心中大喜。
“太好了！只要我们今天拿下这小子，替小门主报仇，门主一定会重重赏赐我们所有人！”
说完，他立刻转头对着三位长老厉声吩咐：“三位长老，快跟我联手，别让他跑掉，立刻把他困住！”
石峰、叶尘、封狼三人对视一眼，心底依旧残留着上次落败的忌惮。
此前他们联手都没能护住修为七层中期的林岳，好在如今有炼气境八层中期的赵威护法坐镇主导战局，战力远超之前。
他们瞬间底气大增，有十足的把握拿下陈阳。
更何况此刻陈阳孤身一人，不像上次还有白若兰等人从旁协助。
念头落下，三位长老不再犹豫，同时迈步上前，身形快速移动，瞬间从四面八方将陈阳牢牢围在中间，彻底封死了他所有退路。
看着四周将自己团团围住的四人，陈阳眼底掠过一抹戏谑，心底只觉得格外好笑，这群人明明实力差距悬殊，却还一副胜券在握的模样。
对面的赵威见陈阳不仅毫无惧色，反而面露笑意，当即眉头紧锁，面色冷厉，冷哼一声厉声呵斥：“死到临头了，你还笑得出来？”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Awakening of the Yin and Yang Magic: I felt so good after the breakup, Volume 1: Default Chapter 270 is really funny (..la) Shi Feng, Ye Chen, and Feng Lang looked at each other again, and shook their heads slightly at the same time.
Shi Feng spoke cautiously: "We can't say for sure yet.
If they still don't show up tonight, we will readjust our plans and make other plans. "
Ye Chen immediately added: "I have already arranged for manpower to guard all exit checkpoints in the city. As long as they want to leave Shantou City, we will receive the news as soon as possible and they will never be able to escape."
Feng Lang had a stern face and said coldly: "That boy Chen Yang is arrogant and arrogant. He will never run away in embarrassment easily."
While several people were talking, the night sky outside the hotel door flashed with light and shadow.
Chen Yang landed steadily and immediately released his invisibility, revealing his figure in the night.
His eyes shimmered, activating his clairvoyance ability, and quickly scanned the entire hotel lobby, taking in a panoramic view of the interior scenes.
In an instant, he locked onto the three elders Shi Feng, Ye Chen, and Feng Lang in the lobby, as well as Zhao Wei and his group who had just arrived.
He quickly scanned the rest of the corners of the lobby again, confirming that there was no ambush and that Lin Hao was completely missing, before he turned his attention back to Zhao Wei and the others.
Chen Yang felt ecstatic in his heart and secretly sighed: God is really helping me!
As long as he absorbs all the cultivation bases of these people, he will definitely have a chance to break through to the late ninth level of Qi Refining Realm in one fell swoop.
By then, his own strength will be completely equal to Lin Hao. If he faces him again, his chances of winning will be greatly improved, and it will be much easier to deal with him.
Thinking of this, Chen Yang was filled with excitement. Without any hesitation, he quickly rushed into the hotel lobby in a flash.
The moment he stepped into the lobby, he glanced at the four people lightly, and his tone was a bit joking: "What? Are you waiting for me here with such a large array?"
Suddenly hearing the sound, the eyes of Zhao Wei, Shi Feng, Ye Chen, Feng Lang, and the two disciples all focused on Chen Yang, and the atmosphere instantly became tense.
The moment they saw the person clearly, the expressions of the three elders Shi Feng, Ye Chen, and Feng Lang suddenly changed. Their faces were full of shock, and their eyes were full of disbelief. They never expected that Chen Yang would actually dare to come to the door alone.
Zhao Wei was keenly aware of the strangeness of the three elders, turned to look at Shi Feng, and confirmed in a deep voice: "Elder Shi, is this kid Chen Yang?"
"Yes, that's him!" Shi Feng gritted his teeth and nodded, his eyes full of fear and hatred.
Zhao Wei looked up and down at Chen Yang in front of him. He was young and had a restrained aura. He tried his best to explore, but he couldn't see through the depth of his cultivation at all.
Even so, his face was still full of joy and his heart was overjoyed.
"Great! As long as we take down this kid today and avenge the little sect master, the sect master will definitely reward us all heavily!"
After saying that, he immediately turned to the three elders and sternly ordered: "Three elders, join forces with me quickly, don't let him run away, trap him immediately!"
Shi Feng, Ye Chen, and Feng Lang looked at each other, still feeling the fear of losing last time in their hearts.
Previously, they had not been able to protect Lin Yue, who was at the mid-seventh level of cultivation. Fortunately, Zhao Wei, who was at the mid-eighth level of Qi Refining Realm, was now here to dominate the battle, and his combat power was far greater than before.
Their confidence instantly increased and they were absolutely sure to take down Chen Yang.
What's more, Chen Yang is alone at this moment, unlike last time when Bai Ruolan and others were assisting him.
After the thought fell, the three elders no longer hesitated and stepped forward at the same time. They moved quickly and instantly surrounded Chen Yang from all directions, completely blocking all his escape routes.
Looking at the four people surrounding him, Chen Yang's eyes flashed with a hint of amusement, and he felt particularly funny in his heart. These people were obviously very different in strength, but they still looked like they had a chance to win.
Zhao Wei, who was on the opposite side, saw that Chen Yang not only showed no fear, but also had a smile on his face. He immediately frowned, his face was cold and stern, and he snorted and scolded: "When death is imminent, can you still laugh? "
